limitations: All 9 races (198-206) were reviewed. Each race's official HKJC replay-full file (English, 2500 kbps) was downloaded with HTTP 200. Video review used re-encodes of those files (720p, and 540p for R1) because the first attempts on the original and multi-race files failed with resource_exhausted errors. Each race was reviewed on its own.

Replays: only the official broadcast angles (side pan, plus head-on or slow-motion finish replays where the broadcast included them); no patrol footage. The early wide pan hid individual contacts in start scrambles for most races.

Incidents not confirmable on video, recorded from the stewards report only: R1 Massive Glory/Ocean Impact near 2100m and the severity of Star Brose/Ocean Impact on jumping; R2 the individual start contacts (Tactical Command, Spicy Spangle, Gimme Five, Thousand Cups); R4 Lucky Together bumped near 750m; R5 Enjoy Golf's awkward jump and Private Wealth's saddle shifting forward and keenness; R6 Boltz bumped early; R8 Aurio/Gustosisimo contact at the start and Devas Twelve hitting the running rail (laying in is consistent with the replay); R9 the start contacts involving Do You Just, Malpensa and Meowth, and the keenness of Malpensa and Meowth.

Replay-only flags (not in the stewards report): R1 Star Brose, Kasa Papa and Our Lucky Glory strong_closer; R2 Golden Friendship and Diriya strong_closer, Mapogo faded_after_leading; R3 Better And Better strong_closer, Gallant Triumph faded_after_leading; R4 Flying Amani strong_closer; R5 Private Wealth and My Day My Say strong_closer, Navas G and Enjoy Golf faded_after_leading; R6 Looking Bright wide_no_cover, Copper Core strong_closer; R7 Windlord soft_lead (replay interpretation, not a sectional finding), Prestige Good blocked and more_in_hand, Turin Champions wide_no_cover; R8 Motor wide_no_cover, Greater Bae strong_closer, Devas Twelve, Majestic St Paul's and Gustosisimo faded_after_leading; R9 Danica's Choice wide_no_cover, The Heir strong_closer, Do You Just faded_after_leading.

Identity caution: in R2 the video review put ALWAYS MY FOLKS (#5) prominent early, but its official running positions are 11-9-4, so that placement was dropped. Rows use official running positions wherever the reviewer's early placings differ.

Vet findings are copied verbatim from the official stewards report: R1 SUPER HONG KONG lame in its right front leg (official veterinary examination required); R3 LUNAR DASH irregular heart rhythm, previously reported on 14.2.26 (barrier trial and vet examination required); R4 MORGAN SUCCESS irregular heart rhythm, and an endoscopic examination also showed a substantial amount of blood in its trachea (barrier trial and vet examination required; this is a tracheal endoscopy finding, not a report of bleeding from the nostrils); R6 PRESTIGE WIN withdrawn on 17.11.26 with an irregular heart rhythm, previously reported on 12.2.25 (barrier trial and vet examination required); R8 AMAZING KID laceration to the right hind leg. No diagnosis is inferred from the video.
Withdrawn horse (stewards-only row, so it has no draw, odds, running positions or sectional): R6 PRESTIGE WIN, replaced by Standby Declared Starter HAPPY UNITED.

Timing: HKJC published no official finish clock time. R9 was advertised for 22:50 HKT. The review started at about 00:54 HKT on 19 Nov, at least 2h after the advertised R9 time, with official results for all 9 races and the full stewards report (R1-R9, General and Summary) published and no interim or adjourned wording visible.
Going: GOOD for all 9 races on the turf C course (penetrometer 2.72). The track was rolled after Race 4. No surface or bias conclusion is drawn from this single card.
Opinions from the video reviewer (e.g. 'would have finished closer', 'most in hand') are untested hypotheses. They are kept out of the official fields and only appear in notes labelled as replay.

rows.stewards_excuse: Bumped shortly after the start. When questioned regarding the tactics adopted from the 1000 Metres where K Teetan commenced a forward move, K Teetan stated that he was instructed to hold an on-pace position and not to contest the lead if GOLDEN FORTUNE, the expected leader, went forward. He said his instructions were also that if the pace of the event was being run outside of standard time he was given the option of making a move in the race as YOUNG FIGHTER is one-paced. He said after being crossed by GOLDEN FORTUNE in the early stages, near the 1500 Metres he shifted to GOLDEN FORTUNE’s outside when the pace of the event was being run outside of standard time. He added entering the Back Straight near the 1000 Metres he elected to comply with his instructions and made a forward move as he was of the opinion this would provide his mount with the opportunity to finish in the best possible placing in the race. He said after improving past GOLDEN FORTUNE near the 900 Metres he then continued to ride his mount along as he was of the opinion by obtaining a break on the field would give his mount the best chance of winning the event. Mr C K Chung representing Trainer C Fownes, who was not present tonight, confirmed the instructions issued. Sent for sampling post-race.

Further he continued to make insufficient effort to prevent RED BRICK WARRIOR from shifting out when insufficiently clear of CLASS, resulting in CLASS having to be checked to avoid RED BRICK WARRIOR. K Teetan was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 25 November 2026 and to expire on Monday, 30 November 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays). In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his neutral race riding record.

rows.stewards_excuse: In the middle stages raced keenly. For some distance near the 200 Metres and again near the 100 Metres Apprentice H Y Yuen had difficulty using her whip when positioned close to TURIN CHAMPIONS. When questioned Apprentice Yuen stated that her instructions were to hold an on-pace position in the first four. She said after jumping well from her inside barrier she was reluctant to ride her mount along in the early stages as PRESTIGE GOOD has previously raced keenly in its races. She said having regard to the horse’s racing manners she did not encourage her mount to hold a position initially behind CALL ME TOPSEED and then behind LIONS SPIRIT when LIONS SPIRIT shifted to the rail. Assistant Trainer Y K Lau confirmed the instructions issued. After considering her explanation the Stewards advised Apprentice Yuen that in the early stages she had made an error of judgement in not endeavouring to comply with her instructions by firstly attempting to hold a position behind CALL ME TOPSEED and then by allowing her mount to lose ground behind LIONS SPIRIT after LIONS SPIRIT crossed to the rail. She was further advised in similar circumstances she would be expected to show better judgement than what she did on this occasion. Sent for sampling post-race.
